summary: Gone: 1929 camp, 1930 cabin and platform tower, removed or destroyed in 1950 (sources differ); a 2022 hiker reached the former site on foot.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1950, or destroyed that year; sources differ. No source describes the site now.

access.note: Reached on foot along a forest trail, per a 2022 hike report. No agency statement on access was found.

visit.trail_note: About 1.75 miles past the Shellrock Mountain trailhead, then an unmarked side trail (2022 hike report).

USFS built a cabin and platform tower

Panorama photos taken Nov 11, 1933 by James Rittenhouse
Register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
Registered Sept 20, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org and firelookout.com date a camp to 1929 and the cabin and platform tower to 1930. Oregon Lookouts dates a 14x14 L-4 lookout house to c.1933. The story gives both.
firetower.org says removed in 1950; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1950; Oregon Lookouts says removed with no date. The story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the sources on elevation (1,280 m), gone status, L-4 design and 2010 registration; no corrections proposed. Access 'public' is inferred from a 2022 hike report that walked to the site, not from an agency statement; the brief said 'unknown'. No source describes remains today. Dating conflict (1930 vs c.1933) and removal conflict (removed vs destroyed, 1950) are unresolved in the sources. Photos on firetower.org (National Archives Pacific Northwest Region panoramas) not recorded: no per-photo licence was read.
